entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are accused in G.R. Case No.1251 of 2022 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M.,
Dhenkanal, arising out of Dhenkanal Town P.S. Case No.526 of 2022 for commission of the offence under Sections 419/420/120-B/468/471/34 IPC.
3.
Being aggrieved by the rejection of their application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Dhenkanal, by order dated 22.10.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioners are in custody since 26.09.2022 and charge sheet has been filed on 23.11.2022.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that even if the entire allegation of the FIR is taken into account at its face value keeping in view the statement of the Informant, the Petitioners are only liable to pay Rs.50,000/- so far as complicity of Petitioner No.1 is concerned and as regards Petitioner No.2, he states that there is no substantial allegation against him.
6.

Learned counsel for the State on the basis of the recitals in the case diary and the materials on record submits that there is an agreement which prima facie shows that a sum of Rs.4 lakhs was paid to the present Petitioners along with other two co-accused, namely, Tikina Mallik- Petitioner in BLAPL No.12750 of 2022 and Nirmal Dhal @ Nirmal Kumar Dhal- Petitioner in BLAPL No.11098 of Debasish Pattnaik & Another vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70321590/
1 2022.
7.

entities.text: BLAPL No.11098 of Debasish Pattnaik & Another vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Considering the nature of allegation and filing of the charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioners to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin subject to verification of the criminal antecedent of similar nature.
8. If the Petitioners have any such antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.

9. Additionally it is directed that taking into account the allegation that all the Petitioners in connivance with each other have taken Rs.4 lakhs which comes to the fore on the basis of the agreement, which is on record, this Court directs the Petitioners to furnish cash security of Rs.1,00,000/- (rupees one lakh) before the learned Court in seisin.
10. The same shall be kept in a short term interest bearing account to be pledged in the name of the court and subject to final outcome of the trial.
11. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge PKS Debasish Pattnaik & Another vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70321590/
